author: Unauthored
body:
Minecraft Username: Unauthored
Discord ID: Sem#1234
In 1 or 2 sentences, tell me who you are: My name is Sem, I'm a 25y/o full-time entrepreneur, I have 900k+ followers on Instagram and a $500k passive yearly income, I run a real estate business. I am someone who works as a real team-player, I expect no more from the others than what I expect from myself.
What is your Planet Minecraft account? - N/A
What is your reddit account? - N/A
Have you ever advertised a Minecraft server before? No, I have not, but I have the experience since I run a successful business and plan a startup in the near future.
What ideas/help can you bring to this team? In addition to my experience, I would like to implement a concept my business implemented called STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result). I believe, by using the STAR concept, we can create a well-structured narrative that will help us rise above the competition.
How active are you/how is your work ethic? I would describe my work ethic with three words. Discipline, responsibility and teamwork. I'm committed to my job and I take responsibility if I fail. I believe that teamwork is the key to success, if you want to reach success it must be done as a team effort.
